issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies the attributes numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double, but the reference solution declares both fields as int. This inconsistency can mislead students about the required field types and consequently the expected constructor/getter/setter signatures for these attributes.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent: either update the UML/problem statement to use int for both student-count attributes (recommended for counts), or change the solution (and consequently expected constructor/getters/setters) to use double for these two fields.
